I’ve spent my post-turkey haze powering through reams of deals on smart home gadgets to find the best discounts on some of my favorite products.

Smart home is often one of the best categories to shop around Black Friday, as it’s traditionally when robot vacuums, video doorbells, smart locks, and thermostats see their lowest prices of the year. And this year does not disappoint! Roborock’s flagship Saros 20 is under $1,000 for the first time, and Ecobee’s excellent Smart Thermostat Premium has finally dropped under $200 (for Costco members and today only).

In a recent development, I also spotted some great first-time discounts on the latest Bird Buddy smart bird feeder I reviewed this summer, along with the latest Alexa digital photo frame I’m currently reviewing. This time of year is also a good opportunity to grab a bargain on higher-priced items you may have been eyeing for a while, such as Skylight’s giant 27-inch digital wall calendar, GE Profile’s fun smart mixer, and Aqara’s new high-tech UWB smart door lock that unlocks as you approach.

Here are some of the best deals I’ve spotted so far. We’ll keep this list updated, so check back often!

This RGB smart lamp packs a JBL speaker inside to combine snazzy lighting effects and decent sound into one fun, portable package. Battery-powered and with support for Matter, this is a smart light with party speaker aspirations. It’s the perfect size to add a little punch to your next gathering or snazz up a college dorm room. Read our review.

It has been revealed that LIFX’s dimmable, color-changing bulbs offer Wi-Fi connectivity, simple setup, and Matter compatibility, so they work with any major smart home platform. The organization is right now trialing a Thread beta that will bring the option to add Thread connectivity to all its Matter devices.

In a recent development, A 10-inch anti-glare touchscreen that comes in a few design options. It’s a frame that features Alexa, and doubles as a smart speaker. It works with Amazon Photos, which offers unlimited storage for Prime members.

Recent findings suggest that this innovative upcoming smart lock uses the U1 ultra-wideband (UWB) chip in many iPhones and Apple Watches to automatically unlock your door as you approach. It also works with the new Aliro standard, making it compatible with Android phones for hands-free unlocking. Read our review.

The Birdbuddy Nook is the tech giant’s least expensive and smallest model, and it packs a lot of bang for your buck. Its 4K HDR camera delivers excellent image quality and a 3.8-cup seed capacity means less frequent refills. An optional solar panel extends the already good battery life. Read our review.

Sources indicate that roborock’s first roller-mop robot vacuum, the Curv 2 Flow, features flagship specs at a midrange price, including excellent mopping, a retractable mop cover, 20,000Pa suction, AI-powered obstacle avoidance, and a compact design. Read our review.

Industry observers note that these smart lights have beautiful colors, a nice selection of festive scenes, and an easy-to-use app. They are super reliable when paired with a Hue Bridge and also work over Bluetooth. They come in three lengths, work with all the major smart home platforms, and are Matter-compatible. Read our review.

Sources indicate that A digital touchscreen display designed to help families manage calendars, to-do lists, meals, and chores. It connects to Wi-Fi, features a 27-inch screen that can display photos when not in use. Read our review.

According to recent reports, power over Ethernet provides this 2K resolution video doorbell with rock-solid connectivity while reducing the number of wires you need. There’s no subscription required to view recorded video: it can record locally on a microSD card, Reolink Hub, or FTP server and connect to a platform like Home Assistant.

Even if your mom lives halfway around the world, the Aura Aspen can help her feel close. The 12-inch display looks more akin to a traditional photo frame than other models, in part due to an antiglare screen, slim bezels, and a 4:3 aspect ratio. It can also automatically showcase images via Google Photos, iCloud Photos, or a companion app, the latter of which even allows for text captions. Read our review.

The Narwal Flow 2 is an excellent robot vacuum for hardwood floors. A superb mop with a wide flat roller pad and a good vacuum, the Flow 2 also has top-notch navigation and obstacle detection. Its sleek base station is also less of an eyesore than most models. Read our review.

This kit is everything you need to get started with Lutron’s excellent smart lighting system and turn your existing wired lights into smart ones that you can control from anywhere. It replaces your standard wall switch and works with all the major smart home systems, making it easy to dim or adjust multiple lights from your wall switch, your phone, or with your voice.

In a recent development, this smart plug offers the most detailed energy monitoring of any we’ve tested. It supports Matter over Thread and is a good choice for Apple Home and SmartThings users, as it offers energy monitoring on those platforms.

According to recent reports, this smart mixer is great for the tech-forward baker. With a built-in digital scale, Auto Sense and Active Stir to take some of the busy work off your hands, it features a high-powered motor with a 7-quart bowl. It’s compatible with all front-mounted KitchenAid attachments. Read our review.

SwitchBot’s Matter-compatible Smart Candle Warmer lets you set schedules to turn it on and off in the app or any connected smart home platform and have pleasant scents waft safely throughout your home on demand.

According to recent reports, at more than half off, Ring’s 2K battery-powered video doorbell is a great deal offering 2K video and easy installation. However, its battery is built in, so you’ll need to remove the doorbell to charge it via USB-C.

The Echo Dot Max features a flat design and a redesigned sound system, which delivers nearly three times the bass as its predecessor. It also offers improved conversation detection and better noise filtering, thanks to Amazon’s new AZ3 chip. Read our review.

According to recent reports, this bot can climb high transitions between rooms and get over obstacles, meaning it’s less likely to get stuck than other bots. The Saros 20 is also really slim, just 3.13 inches tall, small enough to squeeze under most furniture, and it’s equipped with excellent obstacle avoidance making it a great robot for cluttered households. Read our review.

Industry observers note that this fun smart lamp can light up your ceiling or cast a warm white reading light over a chair, making it super versatile. It has three separate lighting zones that can display white or color-changing lights and offers a huge array of dynamic effects. It supports Matter, so will work with all the major smart home platforms.

Recent findings suggest that the Ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium is an excellent option for adding smarts and some style to your HVAC system. As well as being a smart way to control your energy use, the thermostat can also act as a video intercom for Ecobee’s excellent doorbell camera and an indoor air quality monitor. Read our review.
